objectName: Self-watering plant system (alt to a $129 smart auto-waterer)
designPhilosophy: Modular 3D-printed 1.4L watertight PETG reservoir, snap-fit grommet lid, pump isolation cradle, ESP32 side-mount enclosure, tube routing clips, flow wheel, and root-zone dripper stakes paired with 7 off-the-shelf components.
summary: Modular 3D-printed 1.4L reservoir, snap-fit grommet lid, pump isolation cradle, ESP32 side-mount enclosure, tube routing clips, flow wheel, and root-zone dripper stakes paired with 7 off-the-shelf components.
assemblyNotes: All 9 unique printed parts (13 total printed items) orient flat on the print bed with zero support material required.
Print PRT-01 (Water Reservoir Base) and PRT-03 (Pump Cradle) in PETG with 4 perimeters for 100% watertightness.
Routing the silicone tubing through the top lid grommet and rim C-clips prevents passive gravity siphoning.

parts.name: Water Reservoir Base (1.4L)
parts.description: Watertight 1.4-liter reservoir bucket with 3.5mm perimeter walls and rounded internal corners.
parts.roleInAssembly: Primary structural base and 1.4L water storage vessel.

parts.name: Snap-Fit Reservoir Lid with Port Grommets
parts.description: Top cover with center 10mm outlet tube port, 22mm refill funnel port, and 8mm pump cable grommet.
parts.roleInAssembly: Seals reservoir top and provides ports for tubing, power wire, and refill funnel.

parts.name: Submersible Pump Isolation Cradle
parts.description: Centers the 5V submersible micro-pump on the reservoir floor and dampens vibration noise.
parts.roleInAssembly: Holds OTS-01 pump at center of reservoir floor.

parts.name: Wide-Mouth Top Refill Funnel
parts.description: Drop-in conical funnel for spill-free top watering refills without removing the lid.
parts.roleInAssembly: Fits into the 22mm corner port on the reservoir lid for easy refilling.

parts.name: ESP32 & MOSFET Controller Enclosure
parts.description: Protective splash-resistant housing for the ESP32 dev board and 5V MOSFET switching module.
parts.roleInAssembly: Houses and protects ESP32 microcontroller and MOSFET driver board.

parts.name: Reservoir Side-Mount L-Bracket
parts.description: Heavy-duty L-bracket that hangs the electronics enclosure on the side of the water reservoir.
parts.roleInAssembly: Mounts controller enclosure to the side wall of the reservoir.

parts.name: Rim-Snap 6mm Silicone Tube Clip
parts.description: Snap-fit C-clips that secure the 4/6mm silicone tubing along the reservoir rim and plant pot edge.
parts.roleInAssembly: Guides and secures silicone delivery tubing along the rim.

parts.name: Root-Zone Soil Emitter Stake
parts.description: Tapered J-hook soil anchor that holds the drip tube outlet directly over the plant root ball.
parts.roleInAssembly: Anchors delivery tube in plant soil and directs water to roots.

parts.name: Rotary Drip Flow Restrictor Wheel
parts.description: Knurled thumb-gear pinch wheel to fine-tune water flow rate between emitter branches.
parts.roleInAssembly: Pinch-regulates water flow through the 6mm silicone tube.

parts.name: 5V Mini Submersible Water Pump (120 L/h)
parts.description: Ultra-quiet 3-5V DC brushless micro submersible centrifugal water pump with 7mm outlet barb.
parts.roleInAssembly: Pumps water from reservoir base through silicone tubing to plant stakes.

parts.name: Food-Grade 4mm ID / 6mm OD Silicone Tubing (2m)
parts.description: Flexible kink-resistant 4mm inner / 6mm outer diameter silicone irrigation hose.
parts.roleInAssembly: Conveys water from submersible pump outlet to root-zone drip stakes.

parts.name: Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensor v1.2
parts.description: Corrosion-resistant capacitive probe with onboard 3.3V regulator and analog voltage output.
parts.roleInAssembly: Measures soil dielectric moisture continuously and feeds analog signal to ESP32.

parts.name: ESP32-WROOM-32 USB-C Development Board
parts.description: Wi-Fi + Bluetooth microcontroller that reads soil moisture and triggers timed watering cycles.
parts.roleInAssembly: Main controller processing moisture readings and driving MOSFET switch.

parts.name: 5V Logic-Level MOSFET Switch / Relay Module
parts.description: Opto-isolated MOSFET driver module allowing 3.3V ESP32 GPIO pins to switch the 5V water pump.
parts.roleInAssembly: Switches 5V DC power to the submersible water pump on command from ESP32.

parts.name: 5V 2A USB-C Power Supply + 1.5m Braided Cable
parts.description: Standard 10W 5V USB-C wall adapter powering both the ESP32 and submersible pump.
parts.roleInAssembly: Supplies regulated 5V 2A DC power to controller and pump.

parts.name: Dupont Jumper Wires & M3x10mm Stainless Screws
parts.description: Female-to-female 20cm Dupont jumper ribbon and 4x M3x10mm fasteners for bracket mounting.
parts.roleInAssembly: Fastens controller box to L-bracket and interconnects sensor, MCU, and MOSFET.
